name: Git Credential Manager
description: Installs Git Credential Manager (GCM) as a .NET tool and configures it as Git's credential helper for every user, storing credentials in the Secret Service keyring, which the keyring Feature provides. With version 'latest', add the agentbox Feature to keep it on the latest release.

github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: This dev container includes Git Credential Manager (`git-credential-manager`), configured as Git's credential helper with the Secret Service keyring as its store. Git prompts for sign-in on first use of a remote and reuses the stored credentials afterwards.
